description: `ui-health reindex run` walks every scenario, dispatches `InventoryService.ScanScenario` to the appropriate per-framework component-library scenario (today: `react-component-library`), aggregates `ScanResponse`, embeds each `SurfaceRecord` via the Ollama `embedding.default` role, and upserts to Qdrant collection `ui-health-surface`.

requirements.description: The CLI command `ui-health reindex run` must walk every registered scenario, dispatch `InventoryService.ScanScenario` to the appropriate per-framework component-library scenario (initially `react-component-library`), aggregate the returned `ScanResponse`, embed each `SurfaceRecord` via the Ollama `embedding.default` role, and upsert the resulting vectors and payloads to the Qdrant collection `ui-health-surface`.
requirements.title: On-Demand Reindex with Framework Dispatch and Qdrant Upsert

validation.notes: Framework dispatcher correctly routes to `react-component-library` scenario for React-based scenarios
ScanResponse aggregation merges SurfaceRecords from multiple scenarios without duplication
Each SurfaceRecord is embedded individually via the Ollama embedding role before upsert
Qdrant upsert operation targets the `ui-health-surface` collection
Run `ui-health reindex run` against a test corpus and confirm all scenarios are walked
Confirm `InventoryService.ScanScenario` is invoked once per scenario with correct parameters
Confirm all returned SurfaceRecords appear as points in the `ui-health-surface` Qdrant collection after reindex
Confirm that re-running reindex updates existing points rather than creating duplicates (upsert semantics)
Reindex of 50 scenarios with 200 surface records each completes within 10 minutes
Embedding calls are batched where Ollama API supports batching to minimize round-trip overhead
Search results reflect the latest component inventory after a reindex run

requirements.description: The `ui-health reindex run` command must create a trackable job with a unique job_id returned on start. The job must record per-scenario progress so that status can be queried.
requirements.title: Reindex Job Lifecycle and Progress Reporting

validation.notes: A unique job_id is generated and printed to stdout when `reindex run` starts
Job state transitions: PENDING → RUNNING → COMPLETED or FAILED
Partial scenario completion is recorded incrementally so status reflects real-time progress
Start a reindex job and immediately query status; confirm state is RUNNING and scenarios_completed < scenarios_total
Wait for reindex completion and query status; confirm state is COMPLETED
Operators can monitor long-running reindex operations without blocking the terminal

title: On-demand reindexing with framework dispatch
